empty.title: No clients yet
empty.body: Clients are optional. Keep a simple directory of customers you work with and link them to projects when helpful.

create.title: New client
create.description: Save the company (or household) name, and optionally the person to call - company phone is separate from the contact person.
create.walkInHint: For a walk-in client - save the company name now. Add a contact person if you already have a name and phone.
create.companySectionHint: The customer company or household - not a person.
create.contactSectionHint: Who to call on site or for day-to-day questions. Separate from the company office phone.

detail.title: Client profile
detail.contactsEmpty: No contact people yet. Add who to call - separate from the company phone above.
detail.identifiersHint: Used for legal exports and customer-facing documents - not required for everyday project work.
detail.archiveConfirm: Archive this client? Existing projects keep their link; the client is hidden from the directory.
detail.removeContactConsequence: You can add a contact again at any time. Project-specific contacts are cleared only if they pointed at this person.
detail.removeIdentifierConsequence: You can add an identifier again at any time.

financial.title: Financial position
financial.subtitle: Billing and collections for this client from existing billing records. VAT is not profit.
financial.overdueCount: {count, plural, =0 {No overdue records} one {# overdue record} other {# overdue records}}
financial.heldRetentionHint: Still held on finalized billing. Reduces receivable now - not a second invoice.
financial.emptyBilling: No billing records for this client yet.
financial.excludedForeign: {count, plural, one {# record excluded (foreign currency)} other {# records excluded (foreign currency)}}
financial.integrityHint: Outstanding = invoiced - paid - held retention. Credit notes reduce invoiced. Draft and voided records are excluded.

timeline.title: Activity
timeline.subtitle: A chronological view of this client from existing records. Voided billing is shown as void - never as an open invoice.
timeline.error: The activity list could not be loaded. You can try again later.

empty.title: No activity yet
empty.body: When this client is linked to work, quotes, billing, or documents, those events appear here.
